name: Mobile apps
summary: Apps for phones and tablets, for a business, a community or a new idea, from a first working version to a launch-ready release.
builds: Customer apps with accounts, profiles and push notifications
Booking, ordering and loyalty apps for a local or online business
Community and events apps
Apps that work offline and sync when connected
Payments and sign-in with the usual providers
first: We agree the one thing the app must do well, design the key screens, build it in short stages with a test version on your own phone each week, then prepare the store listings.
fit: Founders and organisations with a clear idea who want a first version in users' hands quickly.
needs: A sketch or a short description of what the app does, who uses it and anything it must connect to.

name: Websites for businesses
summary: Websites that explain what you do, load quickly on any screen and make it easy for customers to get in touch.
builds: Brochure and service websites
Landing pages for a campaign or a launch
Contact forms, enquiries and simple content editing
Search-friendly structure and sensible page speed
Your own domain, hosting and email set up
first: We agree the pages and the single action you want visitors to take, design a layout that works on a phone first, then build and launch it with you able to edit the text yourself.
fit: Small businesses, practices and organisations that need a professional site without a long project.
needs: Your logo and any text or photos you have, and examples of sites you like.

name: Games
summary: Playable games, from a small prototype to prove an idea through to a full release.
builds: Casual browser and mobile games
Prototypes to test a game idea with real players
Score tables, accounts and in-game progress
Branded games for a campaign or an event
Art and sound integrated with what you already have
first: We build a small playable version of the core mechanic first, so you can feel whether it is fun before anything else is built around it.
fit: Creators and businesses with a game concept, or a brand that wants something playable.
needs: A description of how the game plays, references you like and who it is for.

name: Web apps and SaaS
summary: Software that runs in the browser: sign-in, a dashboard, subscriptions and the admin area to run it.
builds: Customer portals and member areas
Subscription products with plans and billing
Admin screens to manage users and content
Dashboards that show people what matters
Back end, database and APIs
first: We agree a small first release, such as sign-in plus the one workflow users pay for, launch it to a few customers and extend it from what they actually use.
fit: Startups and teams turning a validated idea into a product.
needs: The main workflow in plain words, who the users are and how you plan to charge.

name: Online shops
summary: Shops that show your products well, take payments through a trusted provider and keep orders organised.
builds: Product catalogues, search and filters
Basket and checkout with a payment provider
Order emails and a simple order list
Stock, discount codes and delivery options
Selling digital products or services as well as goods
first: We launch with a small catalogue and a working checkout, so you can take real orders early, then add products and features as sales come in.
fit: Makers, retailers and small brands starting to sell online or moving off a platform that no longer fits.
needs: Your product list with photos and prices, delivery rules and which payment provider you want.

name: Booking and scheduling systems
summary: Let customers book a time themselves, then confirm and remind them automatically.
builds: Appointment and class booking with live availability
Calendar sync for staff
Email or text confirmations and reminders
Deposits and online payment at booking
A simple admin view for your team
first: We start with one service and one calendar, so bookings, confirmations and reminders work end to end before more services and staff are added.
fit: Clinics, studios, tutors, salons, event organisers and anyone whose diary is full of messages.
needs: Your services, opening hours, how long each appointment takes and your cancellation rules.

name: AI features and assistants
tagline: Assistants that cite and ask first
summary: Add AI to an app or a website: answer questions from your own documents, with sources, and ask a person before anything important is done.
builds: Chat assistants that answer from your documents and show the source
Summaries and drafts inside an existing app
Approval steps before an AI sends or changes anything
Assistants that run on your own servers when data must stay private
Testing so you can see how often answers are right
first: We pick one task, test it on real examples from your work, and show you how often the answers are right before it is built into the product.
fit: Teams that want AI inside a product or a workflow without handing control to it.
needs: The task, a few real examples, and where the data is allowed to go.

name: Dashboards and internal tools
summary: Turn spreadsheets, copy-and-paste and email chains into a simple tool your team uses every day.
builds: Dashboards that pull numbers from your systems
Forms and approval workflows
Order, stock and job trackers
Reports that update themselves
Role-based access, so people see only what they should
first: We replace one painful process first, usually the spreadsheet everyone depends on, then extend the tool once your team trusts it.
fit: Small teams losing hours to manual work and fragile spreadsheets.
needs: The current process, a sample of the spreadsheet or data, and who needs to see what.
